editorial:
Ever feel like you are just not living up to your full potential? You will totally relate to Eddie, a struggling writer whose life is a total mess until he gets his hands on a clear pill called NZT. Once he takes it, he suddenly becomes the smartest guy in the room, learns languages in hours, and makes a fortune on the stock market. It is a wild ride that makes you wonder what you would do if you could actually use every part of your brain. The movie has a cool, high-energy vibe that makes you feel the rush of being a genius.

Bradley Cooper is great here, and the way the colors change when he is on the drug is a really neat touch. The story moves fast and keeps you guessing about who is trying to kill him. While some of the science is a bit silly, the suspense makes up for it. It is a perfect pick for a Friday night when you want something exciting but not too heavy.
endingExplained: By the end, you find out that Eddie is not the only one using NZT. He discovers a conspiracy of other users who are just as smart as he is. Instead of running away, Eddie uses his brain to outsmart his enemies and take over. He creates his own version of the drug that does not have bad side effects. He ends up running for office, using his powers to climb to the top of politics.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about secret drugs and power trips.
